title: FMG-to-MC
description: Turn maps from Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator into explorable Minecraft worlds.
body:
**FMG-to-MC** connects [Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator](https://azgaar.github.io/Fantasy-Map-Generator/) to Minecraft's world generation. Export two GeoJSON files from your map — **Cells** and **Rivers** — place them in the right folder, and generate a world shaped after the geography you designed.

> ⚠️ The mod is still in alpha, so bugs are expected.

---

## Getting Started

**1. Export from Azgaar**

Open your map in Azgaar's Fantasy Map Generator and go to *Export → JSON → Cells* and *Rivers*.

**2. Place the files**

In your `.minecraft` folder (Windows: type `%appdata%` in File Explorer), create the following structure:

```
config/fmgtomc/maps/default/
  |- <YourWorld> Cells.geojson
  |- <YourWorld> Rivers.geojson
```

Any filename works, as long as it contains `cells` or `rivers`.

**3. Create the world**

Launch Minecraft → **Create New World** → **World** → set **World Type** to **FMG Fantasy Map** → **Create World**.

> Dedicated server: set `level-type=fmgtomc\:fmgtomc` in `server.properties`.

---

## Important Notes

**Scale**

By default the world runs at roughly **1:125 horizontal scale** — 1 block in Minecraft corresponds to about 125 meters on your Azgaar map. Vertical scale compresses far less.

**Biomes**

Terrain shape and biomes come from your map. Trees, vegetation, ores, and mobs are provided by the mapped vanilla biomes — the generator only shapes terrain, water, and rivers.

**Rivers**

Only rivers **natively generated** by Azgaar are supported. Rivers manually drawn may not generate correctly.

---

## Recommended mods (not required)

- FerriteCore
- Sodium
